question.text: What percentage of companies globally will fulfill their pre-2026 cage-free commitments in 2026 and 2027?
question.resolution_criteria: This question will resolve as the percentage of global companies reporting in 2026 or 2027 that they have fulfilled the cage-free commitments they made before 2026 according to [Chicken Watch](https://chickenwatch.org/progress-tracker) when accessed by Metaculus on January 1, 2028.
question.fine_print:
Specifically, the denominator will be obtained by selecting the "Cage-Free" issue on the [Chicken Watch](https://chickenwatch.org/progress-tracker?filterK=Cage-free) progress tracker, a "Victory Date" of 1990 to 2025, and a "Timeline" of 2026 and after. The numerator will then be obtained by *additionally* selecting the "Reporting Fulfilled" status.

If Chicken Watch ceases reporting or significantly changes its criteria such that previous reporting is not comparable, this question will be **annulled**.

research:
I couldn't read the live Chicken Watch numbers. That means I have no current value for either the numerator or the denominator.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-05: I tried to open the [progress tracker](https://chickenwatch.org/progress-tracker?filterK=Cage-free) with the filters in the question, but the page builds its data with JavaScript. My tool saw no counts, filters or statuses. The [cage-free page](https://chickenwatch.org/cage-free) only says "over 1000 leading companies" have pledged. Someone will need to read the tracker by hand in a browser.
- How the filters work: the numerator is any pre-2026 commitment due in 2026 or later that shows "Reporting Fulfilled" on 2028-01-01. Nothing in the filters limits this to fulfillment that happened in 2026-2027. So companies that already fulfilled early, including before 2026, probably count. My reading, not confirmed: the denominator mostly holds commitments due in 2026, 2027, 2028 and 2030, where companies typically report late.
- The question's range (3.56% to 30.19%) points to a current value at the low end. I couldn't confirm what that value is.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. Reaching 30% would require large numbers of companies with 2026+ deadlines to report fulfillment by the end of 2027.
- 2026-03-25: Using Chicken Watch data as of 2026-02-02, Faunalytics found 64% fulfillment for commitments due in 2025 or earlier and 93% for those due in 2024. Over 1,000 pledges (about 40% of all pledges) had a 2025 deadline. Even a past-due group reaches only about 64% in the first months after its deadline. The article gives no figures for commitments due in 2026 or later. [Faunalytics](https://faunalytics.org/tactics-in-practice-the-data-behind-corporate-outreach/)

## 4. Base rates
These are fulfillment rates for commitments whose deadlines have already passed. They are not the measure in this question:
- 2021: 85% of commitments that were due had been met. [Poultry Site](https://www.thepoultrysite.com/news/2021/06/new-report-shows-that-85-of-corporate-cage-free-egg-commitments-have-been-met)
- 2022-2023: 88%. [Albert Schweitzer Foundation](https://albertschweitzerfoundation.org/news/cage-free-88-of-commitments-fulfilled)
- 2024-05: 89% for commitments due in 2023 or earlier. [Food Industry Executive](https://foodindustryexecutive.com/2024/05/new-data-shows-89-of-cage-free-egg-commitments-are-fulfilled-by-food-corporations/)
- 2025-08: 92% for commitments due in 2024 or earlier. 85 global companies reported progress in 2024, 25 of them for the first time. [THL](https://thehumaneleague.org/article/2025-cage-free-fulfillment-report)
- 2026-02: 64% for commitments due in 2025 or earlier. [Faunalytics](https://faunalytics.org/tactics-in-practice-the-data-behind-corporate-outreach/)
- On timing: leading US restaurants and convenience stores took an average of 6.57 years to fulfill their commitments (THL's 2025 Eggsposé, cited by Faunalytics). Rates jump in the one to two years after a deadline, and fulfilling well ahead of the deadline is uncommon.
- I found no historical series for this question's exact measure (the share of not-yet-due commitments marked fulfilled), so I can't give a trend or typical variation.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-11-05: No Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market matches this question. The closest is a Kalshi market on whether Cal-Maine says "Cage-Free" on its 2027-01-06 earnings call, at 0.72. It isn't relevant to the resolution. The Kalshi markets on egg prices and Egg McMuffin prices are unrelated.
- I couldn't find the Metaculus community forecast or any expert forecast.

- End of 2026: a large group of 2026 deadlines falls due, including Chick-fil-A's. Fulfillment reports would follow in 2027 sustainability reports and the tracker updates after them.
- Mid-2027: the next fulfillment report and Faunalytics or Chicken Watch data updates are likely.
- Around 2027-09: Fair and Fowl 2027.
- 2027-06-30: forecasts close.
- Risks: bird flu outbreaks, more companies switching to egg credits, and companies withdrawing pledges. EggTrack reports that 50 businesses have withdrawn entirely, and the Open Wing Alliance has pushed Unilever to reinstate its global pledge. A Chicken Watch change to its methodology or statuses could get the question annulled.

## 1. Resolution source

There were no commitment counts or status labels like "Reporting Fulfilled." [Chicken Watch](https://chickenwatch.org/progress-tracker?filterK=Cage-free)
- 2026-11-05: The [Chicken Watch cage-free page](https://chickenwatch.org/cage-free) says only that "over 1000 leading companies" have pledged. It gives no fulfillment figures.
- To get the baseline you need to apply the filters by hand in a browser: Cage-Free, Victory Date 1990-2025, Timeline 2026 and after, then add Reporting Fulfilled.
- How the metric moves:
  - Numerator: it rises as commitments due in 2026 or later get recorded as fulfilled, including early finishers.
  - Denominator: it is mostly fixed, because victory dates are capped at 2025. It can still grow if Chicken Watch adds older pledges after the fact.
  - My inference: the question's range of 3.56% to 30.19% hints that the question writer saw a low baseline, perhaps around 10%. I could not confirm this.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The value is a snapshot to be taken on 2028-01-01, and the 2026 and 2027 deadline years are still open.
- 2026-02 (published 2026-03-25): Faunalytics, citing Chicken Watch, reported:
  - 64% of global cage-free commitments due in 2025 or earlier were fulfilled.
  - 93% of those due in 2024 were fulfilled.
  - Regional rates for 2025-or-earlier deadlines: Europe 70%, Asia 58%, Africa 62%, Latin America 50%.
  - No figure was given for 2026-or-later deadlines.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) The tracker will be read on 2028-01-01, about 14 months from now. Forecasts close on 2027-06-30.

(b) My research could not read the live tracker. The question's bounds look like fractions of a fixed denominator: 3.715% = 12/323 and 30.03% = 97/323. An earlier version of the bounds was about 3.56% = 11/309. So the latest implied value is roughly 12 of 323 commitments marked "Reporting Fulfilled", about 3.7%, taken around question creation in 2026.

(c) If nothing changed, the result would stay at about 3.7%.

(d) If the current trend continued:
- The numerator has moved slowly (11 to 12) while the denominator grew (309 to 323). That points to a modest rise.
- The end-2026 deadline cohort will report in 2027 sustainability reports. Chicken Watch has updated fairly quickly before: the 2025 cohort reached most of a 64% overall rate by Feb 2026.
- If about a third of the denominator has 2026 deadlines and about half of those report fulfillment before the tracker is read, and some later-deadline companies fulfill early, the result would be roughly 12-20%.
- Tracker update lag, a growing denominator and bird flu disruptions such as Chick-fil-A's warning pull this lower.

(e) There is no historical series for this exact measure. Fulfillment rates for past-due cohorts jump within 1-2 years after the deadline, while early fulfillment is rare. A move from about 4% to 10-20% over 14 months is plausible.

(f) There are no markets or expert forecasts for this question. The creator's soft upper bound of about 30% implies an expected value well below that.

(g) Two unexpected scenarios:
- Low: Chicken Watch does few updates before 2028. Or missed and extended 2025 commitments get reassigned into the 2026+ timeline, inflating the denominator. Either could leave the result at 4-6%.
- High: A big mid-2027 data refresh captures most of a large 2026 cohort, plus early fulfillment by 2027-2028 deadline companies helped by ample US cage-free supply. That could push the result to 28-35%.
